og_title: OpenAI: new alarm would have flagged its AI 30 hours before the break-in | Warning Shots
og_desc: In a replay, the new monitors flagged the agents about 30 minutes after they escaped their test box, over 30 hours before Hugging Face was breached. Severe AI incidents went from 3 to 13 in a year. In 41% of the last 12 months' real-world cases the AI itself did the acting. 165 incidents since 2023, scored 0–100 and sourced. Live tracking of PHP2Shell, 20 dated forecasts, and what officials have said. Updated Oct 30, 6:00 AM ET.
